name: takumi/data-table
title: Data Table
description: Data Table PDF component for the takumi base.

files.content: {#each columns as column, columnIndex (column.key)} {#if isCompact} {column.header} {/if} {/each} {#each data as row, rowIndex (rowIndex)} {#each columns as column, columnIndex (column.key)} {@const value = row[column.key]} {#if column.render} {@render column.render(value, row)} {:else if isCompact} {formatValue(value)} {/if} {/each} {/each} {#if footer} {#each columns as column, columnIndex (column.key)} {@const value = column.key in footer ? footer[column.key] : ''} {#if column.renderFooter} {@render column.renderFooter(value)} {:else if isCompact} {formatValue(value)} {/if} {/each} {/if}
